title: Kissed Smoky Ukrainian Cannellini Beans Pastry Casserole
description: A sweet, cheese-pull date-night Ukrainian dish featuring cannellini beans, nuka-pickle, and a sugar-free crust.
instructions: Line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper.
Roll out the almond flour pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to the prepared baking dish and trim the edges.
In a large bowl, combine the cannellini beans, nuka-pickle slices, smoked mozzarella cheese, granulated sweetener, salt, dried thyme, and smoked paprika.
Spoon the bean mixture over the pastry crust.
Brush the edges of the pastry crust with the beaten egg.
Roll out the remaining pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a pastry cutter or a knife to cut the dough into strips.
Place the strips on top of the bean mixture in a lattice pattern.
Brush the strips with the beaten egg and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
